units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 30:38">Targ. Y. Gen. XXX, 38</cite> (O. <he>דעץ</he>).
Targ. Y. Deut. XV, 17; a. fr.—Part. pass. נְעִיץ; f. נְעִיצָא; pl. נְעִיצִין; נְעִיצָן inserted; perforated.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:2">Targ. Cant. II, 2</cite>.—Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ top; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ bot. (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>)<he>מִיצַּע סכינא וכ׳</he> (or <he>למֵיעץ</he>) to stick a knife into a radish.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16">Cant. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>וכדון אפי׳ את מְנַעֲצָהּ וכ׳</he> (not <he>מצנעה</he>) and now, even if you tried to stick into it sixty myriads of reeds &c., v. <cite ref="N00927"><he>נְסֵי</he></cite>; Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ; Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ bot. <he>מבצע</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>כד את נַצְעֲתוֹן</he> (not <he>נצעהון</he>).
